7438.title: Root composer browser ownership is not handed off
7438.rootCauseOneLine: Successful creation navigates without transferring root panel state; native views independently retain and enforce their original thread ownership.
7438.proposedFix: Implement a coordinated root-to-thread native ownership handoff and persist/clear the corresponding UI state; keep ordinary cross-thread reattachment blocked.
7438.caveats: Repeated state-boundary reproduction only; no macOS native UI, native screenshots, server tabs CLI, or page continuity verified. No PR: complete correction crosses app/native ownership contracts, outside the simple-fix gate.
